stations.title: Imogen
stations.say: Can we start selling 500 g tins?
stations.note: One change to the tin, she hopes.

stations.title: Rafe's copies
stations.text: Each copies a tin by hand, and stays old.

captions: Imogen wants to sell 500 g tins at Oakhollow, changing the type of a tin once.
Rafe's copies of the tin type still list the old sizes, so the stock form refuses them.
You make every type around a tin from Tin itself: its names, its size, its parts.
Imogen adds the size to Tin once, and every type around it takes it in.
A tin changes in one place now, and the copies that drifted apart are gone.
